messages:
alex: Async standup — rolling warmup for feature flag `fastpath_v3` in eu-west. Starting at 0% -> 3% over 15m. Link: https://dashboard.redwood.internal/rollouts/fastpath_v3

alex: What I did: kicked off warmup, confirmed model variant selection, started basic smoke test.
Blockers: watching for latency spikes and any prompt regressions.
Today: iterate on any quick fixes, coordinate ramp to 10% if green.

deploybot: Job started: warmup-job/fastpath_v3 (id: wj-8792) — status: in_progress :rocket:

maria: saw a small proxy CPU bump on the first host at t+4m. Pushed a tiny slice config tweak: increased `cpu.request` by 10% for slice eu-fastpath-a. No errors in logs.

maria: config diff (brief):
```yaml
- cpu: 500m
+ cpu: 550m
```

sam: Quick FYI — left CR comments on PR #422 (model-fallback). Need explicit fallback to `small-quant` when kv-cache miss > 2. Ping @alex to prioritize before 10%.

jordan: watching metrics: p95 latency for fastpath_v3 jumped to ~420ms at t+5m, likely due to initial cache warming. Recycled one warmup VM and latency dropped ~80ms. Keeping an eye.

priya: QA flagged a prompt edge-case regression in slot filler for long history prompts (repro steps attached in the issue). Running batch eval against 1% bucket to measure. Blocker: need request logs from the 1% bucket for last 10m. @alex can you enable `kv_cache.debug` for that slice?

alex: Enabled `kv_cache.debug=true` for slice eu-fastpath-a for next 20m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/streams/wj-8792
Also lowered ramp to 1.5% (pausing at 3% -> 1.5%) to slow the rate while we observe.

deploybot: Patch applied: slice-config/eu-fastpath-a (cpu +10%, kv_cache.debug on) — rollout complete :white_check_mark:

maria: LGTM on the config change. Will hold further ramp until QA and latency signals stabilize.

sam: I'll address the CR tonight and add a unit test for the fallback path. If p99 > 1.2s during ramp, please abort.

jordan: Setting an alert: `fastpath_v3.p99_latency > 1200ms` -> notify #oncall and pause ramp automatically.

priya: Running evaluation now; ETA ~12m. Will post sample diffs if regression > 5% on quality metric.

alex: Thanks all. Summary: warmup initiated, micro-config bump applied, kv logging enabled, QA eval running. If we stay green we'll plan +10% at T+45m. Ping here for any blockers. :pray:
